messages:
Marco Chen: Heads-up: planning to enable phoenix-1 in catalog during today's 22:00-23:00 UTC change window. Aim: staged enable (canary -> region -> global). Leaving a short checklist here.

deploy-bot: Scheduled enable queued: model=phoenix-1, mode=staged, canary_regions=[eu-west-1], rollout_steps=3, ticket=ENG-6018. Canary traffic=1%.

Lila Patel: Fallback ordering proposal: 1) phoenix-0 (v1 FP32) pinned, 2) phoenix-0-compat (smaller), 3) phoenix-1-quant only as manual secondary fallback (no auto-promote). Confirming that catalog pin will block quant auto-fallback.

Devon Park: Agree. Add explicit pin: phoenix-0 pinned at priority 900 for this rollout so fallback is deterministic.

Ivy Zhang: Release note blurb for console: "phoenix-1: improved streaming latency and better long-context coherence. No prompt changes required." Will add migration note about subtle tokenization fixes.

Marco Chen: Ops guardrails I want: if 3xx/4xx/5xx combined error-rate > 3% for 3m in canary region -> deploy-bot abort + immediate roll to pinned phoenix-0. If sustained p95 latency increase > 200ms for 7m -> pause and notify owners.

oncall-bot: Creating temporary alert: name=canary-phoenix1-error, threshold=3pct, window=3m, notify=[#eng-oncall, Lila Patel].

ops-bot: Preflight results: artifact SHAs match, model-signature OK, tokenizer parity OK, infra capacity=5 GPUs reserved in eu-west-1. Canary traffic ready.

Lila Patel: Quick smoke to run before canary (staging):
```
curl -s -X POST https://staging.api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" -d '{"model":"phoenix-1","messages":[{"role":"user","content":"Explain Redwood's caching in one paragraph."}],"stream":false}'
```
Expect: http 200, coherent paragraph, no streaming errors.

Devon Park: Observatory note: make sure kv-cache hit-rate metric is exported to canary dashboard and batching histo at 1s granularity. We'll also capture cost-per-token delta.

deploy-bot: Begin step 1: enabling canary in eu-west-1 at 2951234670. Canary traffic=1%.

Marco Chen: Monitoring. I'll watch telemetry for first 10m. Keep oncall loop open.

Ivy Zhang: First 5m look clean: error-rate 0.2%, kv-hit 82%, batch median 6. p95 latency slightly improved (-30ms).

Lila Patel: Noting a tiny spike at 8m in one AZ: p95 +220ms but isolated to AZ-2 worker pool. Error-rate still <1%.

Devon Park: I'm reprovisioning 1 worker in AZ-2 and toggling slower preemption. Hold progression.

deploy-bot: Pausing step 2. Notification sent to oncall and owners.

oncall-bot: Incident note: transient p95 spike in eu-west-1 AZ-2, started at 2951234720. Assigned to Devon Park.

Devon Park: After reprovision, p95 back to baseline within 6m. No errors.

Lila Patel: Recommend continue to regional ramp to 8% and keep quant fallback blocked. :thumbsup:

Marco Chen: Proceed with step 2. deploy-bot, start regional ramp.

deploy-bot: Step 2 started: regional ramp to 8% at 2951234800.

Ivy Zhang: Updating release notes and Console message: "phoenix-1 staged rollout in progress. Customers: verify critical evals if you depend on exact token alignment."

Lila Patel: Add to public notes: timeline ~2 hours to full rollout if steady.

Marco Chen: Final: ENG-6018 updated with rollback playbook. If any abort, deploy-bot will set model pin back to phoenix-0 and notify #eng-release. Logs and metrics snapshot attached to ticket.

deploy-bot: Step 3 scheduled: global enable if stable at 2951235400.

Marco Chen: Thanks team. I'll close the thread when global enable completes or if rollback triggers. Keep short updates in this thread only.

oncall-bot: Reminder: temporary alerts expire in 3 hours.

Lila Patel: Nice coordination. Good to have explicit pin to avoid accidental quanting.

Marco Chen: Closing for now. Will ping if anything changes. :rocket:
